comments.author: vonneumannstan
comments.why: Guido describes using Copilot daily as code review.
comments.text: Yeah unironically. Guido van Rossum - "I use it every day. My biggest adjustment with using Copilot was that instead of writing code, my posture shifted to reviewing code." [VIDEO] Here's Jeff Dean saying 25% of the characters in new PRs at Google are AI Generated. [LINK] Andrej Karpathy - "I basically can't imagine going back to "unassisted" coding at this point" [LINK] Andrew Ng - "I run multiple models on my laptop — Mistral, Llama, Zefa. And I use ChatGPT quite often. " [LINK] Simon Willison [LINK] I mean I can keep going. I doubt you would compare yourself to these people.
